notes:
Lead type: inbound from call-summary app marketplace listing. Small sales enablement startup building a lightweight app that auto-summarizes calls and pushes notes to HubSpot. Very cost-conscious — wants to keep costs per user low.
Key technical asks:
- Must understand how Redwood Hosted API stores logs/requests, TTL options, and how to opt-out of retention.
- Wants explicit guidance on PII handling: best practice is client-side redaction before sending; asking whether Redwood can provide server-side PII redaction tools or classification endpoints.
- Needs audit logs and exportable logs for compliance with customers.
- Prefer public cloud (hosted) to avoid ops overhead; may reassess for Dedicated if volume grows.
- Model preferences: smaller fast chat models for summaries; fallback to higher-quality for longer transcripts.
Quotes: "We can't have credit card data or SSNs leaked—need a simple retention toggle and an exportable audit trail."
POC plan: 2-week hosted API POC using redaction library + sample transcripts; metrics: summary quality (f1 on entity masking), latency under 300ms median for 1-3k token requests, cost per summary target <$0.02.
Open items:
- Provide DPA snippet and hosted retention SLA.
- Confirm whether API logs can be disabled per-account or set to auto-delete after X days.
- Example payloads and recommended prompt engineering for consistent structured summaries.

- "Priya worried about PII"; "AE to send DPA + one-pager"; "Marcus to set up technical Q&A 1/28"
